title: Easy chocolate mousse
description: A classic French mousse with only three ingredients. Make it the day before!
steps: Melt the chocolate gently over a pan of simmering water, then let it cool slightly.
Separate the eggs. Stir the yolks one by one into the chocolate.
Whisk the whites with the salt until they form soft peaks, then add the sugar and whisk until firm.
Fold a third of the whites into the chocolate to loosen it, then gently fold in the rest.
Pour into glasses and chill for at least 4 hours.
